title: Towards Physics of Multimodal Pretraining: Knowledge Flow, Modality Synergy, Early Unification, and Recipes
abstract: Vision offers a critical axis for advancing foundation models, driving a shift towards natively unified multimodal pretraining. Despite this momentum, the design space and the fundamental mechanisms of how modalities interact during unified training remain underexplored. We provide empirical clarity through a systematic exploration of multimodal pretraining. Our controlled experiments on both synthetic and large-scale real-world datasets yield four key insights into the physics of multimodal pretraining: (i) Knowledge Flow: We disentangle how language, visual understanding, and visual generation transfer knowledge across modalities, revealing distinct patterns of influence and asymmetry; (ii) Synergy vs. Competition: We show that data "complexity" largely determines whether modalities are synergistic, identify architectural choices that promote synergy: such as shared attention and normalization with modality-specific feed-forward layers, and find that these behaviors generalize across different visual tokenizer designs; (iii) Early Unification: Unifying modalities from the very early stages and training them jointly is shown to be more effective than late alignment or sequential training. This process uncovers a vision laziness phenomenon, where delayed integration leads models to rely on language priors; (iv) Recipes: We derive efficient pretraining recipes that achieve strong generative performance using only 5% of the compute budget. These core findings are subsequently validated at scale by training multiple 13.5B MoE models on 2T tokens. We hope this study provides a principled foundation for understanding and scaling multimodal pretraining.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.05000v1 全文整理；论文未在 PDF 中提供可用的公开代码 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: 用从 100B 到 2T tokens 的受控实验，把 unified multimodal pretraining 拆成 knowledge flow、synergy/competition、early unification 与 data-mixture recipe 四组可检验规律。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它同时覆盖 VLM/MLLM 与 raster image generation 的 unified pretraining，并给出 data mixture、parameter sharing 和 vision 接入时点三类可直接影响未来模型设计的经验规则。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 13.5B MoE 的 L70/U25/G5 recipe 相对 L50/U25/G25 使 language accuracy +1.45、visual-understanding average +1.66、DPG +0.013、GenEval +0.015，但 diffusion loss 变差 0.011（Table 2, pp. 21–22）；shared attention/norm + modality-specific FFN 在受控实验中表现最佳（Fig. 9, pp. 14–15）。
analysis.caveatZh: 所有 controlled experiments 固定 seed 0，真实世界数据主体 SSTK 不公开；论文只实证 text 与 static images，若干所谓机制仍由 activation/attention proxy 支持，因此不能把四条经验规律直接视为跨规模、跨 modality 的普适定律。
analysis.motivationZh: Unified multimodal models 同时承担 language、visual understanding 与 visual generation，但不同任务之间究竟迁移知识还是争夺容量、应该共享哪些参数、vision 何时接入训练，长期缺少系统的 controlled evidence。
analysis.methodZh: 作者先在 1.5B Llama-3-like 与 2.3B split-FFN models 上控制 data ratio、tokenizer、task complexity、parameter sharing、vision 接入时间和 sequential order；再用扩展 CLEVR 删除指定 concept，区分 zero-shot transfer 与后续 recovery；最后用 activation、wrapper embedding、visual FFN 与 attention readouts分析 vision laziness，并在多个 13.5B MoE、2T-token runs 上验证非对称 mixture、MoE 与 early unification。
analysis.experimentsZh: 受控实验覆盖 100B–1T tokens、四种 visual tokenizer、五种 parameter-sharing pattern、五个 unification time 与六种 sequential order；scaling runs 为 13.5B MoE（每 token 激活 1.5B parameters）训练 2T tokens。作者报告 split-FFN 相对 unimodal controls 同时改善 language PPL 0.211 与 visual diffusion loss 0.0168，而 fully dense 两侧都退化（Fig. 9, pp. 14–15）；joint training 几乎全面超过六种 sequential order，12.5% replay 仍未追平（Fig. 12, pp. 17–18）。
analysis.insightZh: 最值得迁移的不是某个单一比例，而是三条设计顺序：先测知识流方向，再按容量竞争决定 FFN 是否分开，最后尽早让 vision 进入共享 attention/norm。Generation data 占比可以很低，但 alignment metrics、diffusion loss 与 FID 必须分开观察。
